extracted.name: Rival Weekend Hotdogs
extracted.description: It's College football rival weekend. I really don't know which type of hotdogs I like more. Chilidog or hotdogs and sauerkraut. Oh the choices to make. Decisions, decisions? What shall I do? Ok I choose both!!! Lol can't go wrong!!!
ingredient_lines: As needed Sausage Chili sauce see my recipe
instruction_lines: Boil the hotdogs in sauerkraut. Add mayonnaise to the buns, if you want to. Add the hotdogs.
Add a to taste some sauerkraut, mustard and onions. Top off with a bit of the sausage chili sauce. I hope you enjoy!!! I sure did!!
